verdict.rationale: Fly.io's Sprites checkpoint themselves while an agent works and can be rolled back to any checkpoint in seconds. That gives first-party versioning and rollback of the environment where agent-built automations live, but not of automations as discrete, versioned artifacts. Nothing in the evidence shows reviewing, diffing, or approving changes before rollback. missing for 10: automation-level version history, review/diff of changes between versions, documentation on how checkpoints are listed and restored, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Roll back to any checkpoint in seconds
A Sprite checkpoints itself while the agent works, so harnesses like Claude and Codex find everything where they left it.
Checkpoint what works, throw away the rest.
